tickerText: [TENNIS] Alcaraz won his first Paris Masters crown Sunday, beating Ben Shelton 7-6(5), 7-5 for ninth Masters 1000 title and revenge after their US Open quarterfinal • [SQUASH] Paul Coll rallied from a game down to beat Diego Elias 8-11, 11-5, 11-6, 11-8 for his second U.S. Open title as Amina Orfi swept Nouran Gohar for the women's crown in Philadelphia • [BADMINTON] An Se-young beat Akane Yamaguchi 21-12, 15-21, 21-16 at Yeosu to win a record-tying 11th international title of 2026 on home soil • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Worlds closed at Brookhaven as Anna Leigh Waters claimed a 46th Triple Crown, JW Johnson and Tama Shimabukuro rallied from down two games in men's doubles, and John Lucian Goins defended singles gold • [TABLE TENNIS] Japan swept WTT Champions Frankfurt as Tomokazu Harimoto beat Patrick Franziska 4-2 and Hina Hayata edged Satsuki Odo 4-2 after a week with no Chinese players in either semifinal

newsItems.title: Alcaraz Wins Paris
newsItems.excerpt: Carlos Alcaraz took his first Rolex Paris Masters title Sunday, defeating Ben Shelton 7-6(5), 7-5 to claim his ninth ATP Masters 1000 trophy and avenge their US Open quarterfinal.

newsItems.title: An's 11th Title
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 An Se-young edged Akane Yamaguchi in three games at the Korea Open final in Yeosu to tie the record with an 11th international crown in a single season.

newsItems.title: Frankfurt Japan Sweep
newsItems.excerpt: Tomokazu Harimoto and Hina Hayata lifted the men's and women's singles titles at WTT Champions Frankfurt on Sunday after home hope Patrick Franziska fell in a six-game final.

newsItems.title: Waters' Triple Crown
newsItems.excerpt: Anna Leigh Waters closed PPA Worlds with singles, doubles, and mixed gold at Brookhaven—her 46th Triple Crown—while John Lucian Goins repeated as men's singles champion.
